inlines.v: DISORGANIZE, verb transitive [dis and organize. See Organ.] To break or destroy organic structure or connected system; to dissolve regular system or union or parts; as, to disorganize a government or society; to disorganize an army. Every account of the settlement of Plymouth mentions the conduct of Lyford, who attempted to disorganize the church.
